description: Search MapleV's Tesla Model 3 / Model Y collision parts catalog by keyword, OE part number, vehicle model, or category. Returns matching parts with names, OE numbers, grade, category, and CAD list price.

category.description: Filter by category name, e.g. 'Front Bumpers', 'Lighting'.

model.description: Filter to parts that fit this Tesla model.

query.description: Free-text search, any word order: part words, model name and/or OE part number, e.g. 'Model Y front bumper', 'Juniper tail lamp bracket', '1084168'. Every word must match. English, French (Québec shop terms) and Chinese are understood. A 7-digit OE base matches every revision we hold.

name: search_parts
title: Search parts
